title: Zzesty Smoky Tofu Kicked Wrap
description: A quick and delicious smoky German dish featuring marinated tofu, double-fried like a wrap, low in fat with crisp exterior.
instructions: Marinate tofu in a mixture of ketchup, olive oil, salt, pepper, and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Double-fry marinated tofu slices until crispy on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Toast wrap bread lightly in a pan or toaster oven until slightly charred and warm.
Spread tangy mustard sauce over the bottom half of the toasted wrap.
Place crispy tofu slices on top of the mustard sauce.
Top with remaining ingredients such as lettuce, tomato, cheese, and any other preferred toppings.
Fold wrap in half and serve.
